metadata.title: GerarAI · Investment research OS
metadata.description: What changed in your positions, portfolio value, triggered alerts, watchlist and intrinsic-value opportunities.

news.title: Top news
news.error: News could not be loaded. The rest of the page keeps working.
news.empty: No news available at the moment.

attention.title: Needs attention
attention.subtitle: Pending thesis changes and DCA levels from your chosen threshold. A DCA level is not a buy order.
attention.unavailableBoth: Thesis changes and DCA levels could not be checked. Whatever is available is shown below.
attention.unavailableThesis: Thesis changes could not be checked. Whatever is available is shown below.
attention.unavailableDca: DCA levels could not be checked. Whatever is available is shown below.
attention.emptyFiltered: No items in the sources that could be checked.
attention.empty: No pending thesis changes or recent DCA levels from your threshold. Unevaluated or stale data is not shown as current signals.
attention.truncated: Showing the {n} most recent pending thesis changes. Also review the pages of your companies.
attention.dcaInPortfolio: Review the contribution to your position.
attention.dcaNotInPortfolio: Consider an entry, after reviewing the thesis.

steps.title: First steps
steps.subtitle: Three steps so the home tells you what changed in your companies.
steps.followTodo: Add them to the watchlist to see price, valuation and alerts.
steps.buyBody: With your positions you will see the portfolio value and where to place this month's contribution.

portfolio.title: Your portfolio today
portfolio.weightsNote: Weights over the gross value of the positions.
portfolio.empty: You have no positions yet. Add your first investment to see here what changed since the purchase.
portfolio.noCostBasis: We don't have the cost basis of your positions yet. Once it's loaded, you'll see here how your portfolio is doing since the purchase.
portfolio.partial: Among the positions with a cost basis: the gain/loss does not include the others.

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.evaluated: the engine evaluates them every 5 min.

watchlist.empty: You are not following any companies yet.

opportunities.title: Intrinsic value opportunities (DCF)
opportunities.orientation: Engine guidance, not a final valuation
